customManagers.description: versions.env: single-value tool and binary pins (including WAYBILL_CLI_VERSION -- do not add a second manager for it, both would extract the same dep)

packageRules.description: A waybill pin bump is a runtime behavior change; release it as a patch (fix). Matches the github-releases datasource the versions.env custom manager emits -- the pin is a release tarball, not the (private) GHCR package.
prBodyNotes: ⚠️ `WAYBILL_CLI_SHA256_LINUX_*` in `versions.env` are **not** updated by this PR. Run `task waybill:checksums` and commit the result, or every `task build:waybill` will fail checksum verification.

packageRules.description: Base image / tooling / CI action bumps are chores.
